project_type: Next.js 16 CFA exam preparation app with feature-based architecture
build_system: bun (package manager), Next.js build system, no Dockerfile
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run tsc --noEmit (must pass). 2. Run bun run vitest --run (234+ tests must pass, env.test.ts has a pre-existing zod v4 failure to ignore).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external npm installs possible. All packages already installed: recharts, lucide-react, framer-motion, tailwindcss, next 16. Use only pre-installed packages.
contribution_requirements: Never use useSyncExternalStore - use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer. Never call router.push() during render phase. createServerSupabaseClient() can return null. No TODOs, no placeholders. Feature-based folders. No cross-feature imports (extract to src/shared/).
key_patterns: Pages are in src/app/(protected)/. Features in src/features/{name}/. Shared components in src/shared/components/{layout,feedback,ui}/. Navigation config in src/shared/config/navigation.ts. CSS variables for theming (dark/light). localStorage for all user data. Sidebar is 264px desktop with mobile hamburger overlay. Header has search + theme toggle + XP badge.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ - route pages | src/features/ - 22 feature modules | src/shared/components/layout/ - sidebar, header, theme-provider | src/shared/components/feedback/ - empty-state, error-boundary, toast, loading, keyboard-shortcuts-modal | src/shared/config/ - navigation.ts | src/shared/hooks/ - keyboard shortcuts, list navigation | src/shared/lib/ - prisma, supabase, utils | src/shared/annotations/ - notes/bookmarks shared utilities
